_about: Seeded wanted-packet specs. Source of truth for board/WANTED.md and scripts/board.py seed. Each becomes a GitHub issue labelled wanted-packet + seeded + <category>. Edit here, then run: python3 scripts/board.py render

wanted-packet: Buyer demand: a data packet someone needs and would pay for or use
packet-offered: Seller supply: a packet someone has or can build and wants to list
claimed: A seller has committed to build or list this wanted packet
listed: Live on graunt.com; link in the thread
seeded: Opened by Graunt from observed agent use-cases, not yet requested by a named buyer
needs-rights-check: Rights or provenance unclear; resolve before listing
legal-regulatory: Statutes, regulations, courts, licensing boards, enforcement
finance-tax: Tax rates, identifiers, filings, calendars, sanctions

wanted.title: US state professional-licensing board rosters (dental, nursing, medical, pharmacy) with per-record verification URLs
wanted.summary: Monthly licensee snapshots per state and profession, each row carrying the board's own lookup URL.
wanted.what: Per state × profession: license number, licensee name as published, license type, status, issue and expiry dates, public discipline flag, board source URL per record, snapshot date. Start with dental, nursing (RN/LPN/APRN), medical (MD/DO), pharmacy.
wanted.task: "Verify this provider's license is active in Ohio before onboarding" and "list every dentist in Franklin County whose license lapses this quarter".
wanted.coverage_freshness: All 50 states + DC; monthly snapshot, boards that publish daily files welcome at that cadence.
wanted.rights_needed: Internal use and redistribution to the buyer's own users. This is public-record professional data but it is personal data: declare it, state the lawful basis, and honour each board's redistribution terms.
wanted.format: One CSV or Parquet per state-profession, plus a combined index.
wanted.sources_hint: Board bulk downloads and lookup portals; some states (e.g. Ohio eLicense, Texas TDLR, Florida MQA) publish bulk files with stated terms. Do not scrape where terms forbid it; index instead.
wanted.why: Agents doing provider onboarding, credentialing and compliance rebuild this per state today, badly.

wanted.title: US sales and use tax rates by jurisdiction, monthly, with effective dates and source citations
wanted.summary: Combined and component rates for every state, county, city and special district, with the notice each rate came from.
wanted.what: Jurisdiction id, name, level (state/county/city/district), rate component, combined rate, effective date, end date, source document URL, snapshot date. Optional: ZIP+4 or geocode boundary keys.
wanted.task: "What is the combined rate for this address as of today, and what changed since last month?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All US states with a sales tax; monthly, with a diff file.
wanted.rights_needed: Internal use and redistribution to end customers (invoicing). Attribution fine.
wanted.format: CSV plus a monthly diff CSV.
wanted.sources_hint: State departments of revenue publish rate tables and change notices (public records). Compiling them is the work.
wanted.why: Every invoicing or e-commerce agent needs it; most pay for an API when a monthly table would do.

wanted.title: eCFR section-level text snapshots with stable citations and content hashes (Titles 12, 17, 21, 26, 29, 40, 45 first)
wanted.summary: Every CFR section as one record: citation, heading, exact text, effective date, hash, source URL; monthly with diffs.
wanted.what: title, part, section, heading, full text (plain), effective date, amendment history reference, eCFR URL, sha256 of the text, snapshot date. A monthly diff listing sections added, amended or removed.
wanted.task: "Quote 21 CFR 11.10(a) exactly, as of 1 September 2026, with a citation I can verify."
wanted.coverage_freshness: Named titles first, all 50 eventually; monthly; point-in-time retrieval by snapshot date.
wanted.rights_needed: US federal government work: public domain. Redistribution and training allowed; citation of the packet version and hash expected.
wanted.format: JSONL per title plus CSV index.
wanted.sources_hint: eCFR bulk XML and API (public domain). The value is the section-level normalisation, hashes and diffs.
wanted.why: Compliance agents paraphrase from memory and get clause numbers wrong; exact text with a hash ends that.

wanted.title: State statute section-level text snapshots (CA, NY, TX, FL) with citations and hashes
wanted.summary: Plain statutory text per section for the four largest states, with citation, effective date and hash.
wanted.what: state, code, title/chapter, section, heading, plain text (no publisher annotations), effective date, legislative source URL, sha256, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Quote Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 1680 exactly and tell me when it last changed."
wanted.coverage_freshness: CA, NY, TX, FL first; quarterly, or per legislative session.
wanted.rights_needed: Only the state-published text; no publisher annotations or headnotes. Declare each state's terms; several states assert no copyright in statutory text, some do not say.
wanted.format: JSONL per state code plus CSV index.
wanted.sources_hint: Official legislature sites (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, nysenate.gov, statutes.capitol.texas.gov, leg.state.fl.us). Read each site's terms and declare them.
wanted.why: Legal and compliance agents need exact text with provenance; the official sites are hard to query at section granularity.

wanted.title: Exchange trading calendars 2025–2027 (NYSE, Nasdaq, CME, LSE, Euronext, Xetra, TSE, HKEX, SGX, ASX) with early closes and sources
wanted.summary: Holidays, half days and settlement conventions per venue, each with the exchange notice it came from.
wanted.what: exchange (MIC), date, status (closed / early close), close time, settlement convention (T+1/T+2), source notice URL, last verified date.
wanted.task: "Compute the settlement date for a Euronext Paris trade on 2026-12-23" and "is CME Globex open on Juneteenth 2027?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: Ten venues listed, 2025 through 2027; annual refresh plus ad-hoc when an exchange amends its calendar.
wanted.rights_needed: Internal use and redistribution in downstream products. Attribution fine.
wanted.sources_hint: Each exchange publishes its calendar and notices. Compile, cite, and record the verification date.
wanted.why: Treasury, trading and back-office agents get settlement dates wrong on half days; the packages that exist rarely cite the notice.

wanted.title: Global VAT and GST rates with reduced-rate categories, registration thresholds, effective dates and sources
wanted.summary: Standard and reduced rates per country and territory, with what each reduced rate applies to and the tax authority page it came from.
wanted.what: country/territory, rate type (standard/reduced/super-reduced/zero/exempt), rate, category description (goods/services it applies to), registration threshold and currency, effective date, source URL, last verified date.
wanted.task: "What VAT rate applies to an e-book sold to a consumer in Portugal today, and since when?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All countries with VAT/GST (about 175); monthly verification, changes flagged.
wanted.rights_needed: Internal use and redistribution in invoicing. Attribution fine.
wanted.format: CSV plus a change log CSV.
wanted.sources_hint: National tax authorities and official gazettes. The compilation and the reduced-rate categories are the work.
wanted.why: Cross-border commerce agents need reduced-rate categories, which free tables omit.

wanted.title: Consolidated sanctions lists (OFAC SDN + Consolidated, EU, UK OFSI, UN) as a normalised daily snapshot with hashes
wanted.summary: One schema across the four lists, one file per day, one hash per file.
wanted.what: list source, entity id (source native), entity type, primary name, aliases, identifiers (passport, registration, IMO, crypto addresses), nationalities, programs, listing date, source record URL, snapshot date and file sha256.
wanted.task: "Screen this counterparty against yesterday's lists and show me which list, which program and the source record."
wanted.coverage_freshness: The four lists named; daily, retained for 90 days.
wanted.rights_needed: Internal use and redistribution in screening results. Government lists; declare each publisher's terms.
wanted.format: JSONL per list per day plus a combined CSV.
wanted.sources_hint: OFAC, EU FSF, OFSI and UN publish machine-readable lists. Normalising across their schemas is the work.
wanted.why: KYC and payments agents each write the same four parsers; a normalised, hashed feed is what they want to buy.

wanted.title: LEI ↔ national company-registry ID ↔ ticker ↔ SEC CIK crosswalk, monthly
wanted.summary: One row per legal entity linking the identifiers agents actually encounter.
wanted.what: LEI, legal name, jurisdiction, registry authority id and registration number, ISIN/ticker/MIC where mapped, SEC CIK where applicable, parent LEI, status, mapping source and confidence, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Resolve 'Siemens Energy AG' to its LEI, German registry number and Frankfurt ticker, and tell me which mappings are authoritative."
wanted.coverage_freshness: All active LEIs (about 2.8 million); monthly.
wanted.rights_needed: GLEIF data is CC0; SEC data public domain; ISIN-ticker mappings vary by source, declare each. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: GLEIF Golden Copy and mapping files (CC0), SEC company tickers JSON (public domain), OpenFIGI (check terms).
wanted.why: Entity resolution is the first step of every finance agent workflow and the join is nowhere in one place with declared rights.

wanted.title: US federal and state court directory with e-filing URLs, local-rules links and clerk contacts
wanted.summary: Every court as a record with the links an agent needs to file or look something up.
wanted.what: court id, name, level, jurisdiction (state/county/district), address, clerk phone and general email, website, e-filing system and URL, local rules URL, docket search URL, time zone, last verified date.
wanted.task: "Where do I e-file a civil complaint in Travis County, and what are the local rules?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All federal courts and all state trial and appellate courts (about 3,500 records); quarterly verification.
wanted.rights_needed: Internal use and redistribution. Official contacts in official capacity; declare as personal data where a named clerk appears.
wanted.sources_hint: Court websites, state AOC directories, PACER court locator. Compile and verify.
wanted.why: Legal-ops agents hallucinate court URLs; a verified directory with dates fixes that.

wanted.title: US ZIP ↔ county ↔ FIPS ↔ CBSA ↔ congressional district crosswalk with vintage and allocation ratios
wanted.summary: The join table every US geography question needs, with the vintage stated.
wanted.what: ZIP, ZCTA, county FIPS and name, state, CBSA code and name, congressional district (with Congress number), residential/business/total allocation ratios for many-to-many cases, vintage, source.
wanted.task: "Map these 40,000 customer ZIPs to counties and CBSAs, handling ZIPs that span counties."
wanted.coverage_freshness: All US ZIPs; quarterly with HUD releases, annual for districts and CBSAs.
wanted.rights_needed: Redistribution in products. HUD and Census sources are public domain; declare.
wanted.sources_hint: HUD USPS ZIP crosswalk, Census ZCTA relationship files, OMB CBSA delineations.
wanted.why: Analytics agents redo this join badly every week.

wanted.title: US Harmonized Tariff Schedule with duty rates, special-program indicators and effective dates, per revision
wanted.summary: Every HTS line as a record, with general, special and column-2 rates and the revision it came from.
wanted.what: HTS 10-digit code, description hierarchy, unit of quantity, general rate, special rates and program codes, column 2 rate, additional duties (e.g. Section 301/232 flags), revision number and effective date, source URL.
wanted.task: "Classify and rate this SKU for import from Vietnam as of the current revision, with citation."
wanted.coverage_freshness: Full schedule; per USITC revision (several per year).
wanted.rights_needed: US government work, public domain. Redistribution and training allowed.
wanted.sources_hint: USITC HTS downloads (JSON/CSV) per revision.
wanted.why: Customs and trade-compliance agents need it structured with the revision pinned.

wanted.title: FDA NDC directory and drug-label index, normalised weekly, with RxCUI where mapped
wanted.summary: One row per product NDC with labeler, marketing dates, dosage form, route and label reference.
wanted.what: product NDC, package NDCs, proprietary and non-proprietary names, labeler, dosage form, route, marketing category and application number, marketing start/end dates, active ingredients and strengths, RxCUI where mapped, SPL set id, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Is this NDC currently marketed, who is the labeler, and what is its RxNorm concept?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All listed products; weekly.
wanted.rights_needed: FDA data is public domain; RxNorm has its own terms, declare them. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: FDA NDC directory files, openFDA, RxNorm mappings.
wanted.why: Pharmacy and claims agents need a clean, dated snapshot rather than an API with rate limits.

wanted.title: Medical device recalls joined to GUDID device identifiers, weekly
wanted.summary: Recall events with the UDI-DI records they affect, so an agent can match a device in inventory to a recall.
wanted.what: recall number, classification, date, firm, product description, reason, affected UDI-DIs and lot/serial ranges where stated, GUDID brand/model/company fields, source URLs, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Do any devices in this inventory export match an open Class I recall?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: US; weekly.
wanted.rights_needed: FDA data, public domain. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: FDA recall database and AccessGUDID downloads; the join is the work.
wanted.why: Hospital supply-chain agents cannot join these two sources reliably today.

wanted.title: SEC EDGAR company index: CIK ↔ ticker ↔ SIC ↔ state ↔ fiscal-year-end ↔ filer status, monthly
wanted.summary: A clean company master for every EDGAR filer.
wanted.what: CIK, company name and former names, tickers and exchanges, SIC code and description, state of incorporation, business address state, fiscal year end, filer category, latest 10-K/20-F date, EDGAR URL, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Give me every accelerated filer in SIC 7372 with a June fiscal year end."
wanted.coverage_freshness: All active filers; monthly.
wanted.rights_needed: Public domain. Redistribution and training allowed.
wanted.sources_hint: EDGAR company facts, submissions API and tickers JSON.
wanted.why: Research agents rebuild this master from three endpoints every time.

wanted.title: CVE ↔ CPE ↔ affected-version-range daily snapshot (NVD + OSV) in one schema
wanted.summary: Vulnerabilities with normalised affected products and version ranges, one file per day.
wanted.what: CVE id, published and modified dates, CVSS vectors and scores (v3.1, v4), CWE, CPE match strings, ecosystem and package (from OSV), introduced/fixed version ranges, references, source, snapshot date and file hash.
wanted.task: "Which of these 300 dependencies at these exact versions have a CVE published in the last 7 days?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All CVEs plus OSV ecosystems; daily, 30-day retention.
wanted.rights_needed: NVD is public domain; OSV is CC-BY-4.0, attribution propagates. Redistribution needed.
wanted.format: JSONL per day plus CSV index.
wanted.sources_hint: NVD API 2.0 bulk, OSV.dev bulk exports.
wanted.why: Security-triage agents want a dated snapshot they can hash and cite, not a rate-limited API.

wanted.title: US state data-breach notification requirements matrix with statute citations, quarterly
wanted.summary: For each state: what counts as personal information, deadlines, thresholds, regulator notice rules, content requirements, with the statute section for each cell.
wanted.what: state, statute citation and URL, definition of personal information (structured elements), harm threshold, individual-notice deadline, regulator-notice trigger and deadline, consumer-reporting-agency notice trigger, required notice content, encryption safe harbour, penalties, last amended, verified date.
wanted.task: "We lost 1,200 records of Texas and Illinois residents including driver's licence numbers; what must we do and by when, with citations?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: 50 states + DC + territories; quarterly.
wanted.rights_needed: Original compilation from public statutes. Redistribution to the buyer's clients needed.
wanted.sources_hint: State statutes (official sites). This is analysis work; declare it as the seller's own compilation with citations.
wanted.why: Incident-response agents need a matrix with citations, not a law-firm PDF.

wanted.title: Standards catalogue metadata (ISO, IEC, IEEE, ASTM, NIST SP): identifier, title, status, edition, dates, supersession
wanted.summary: Metadata only, no standard text: enough for an agent to cite the right edition.
wanted.what: publisher, identifier, edition/year, title, status (current/withdrawn/draft), publication date, withdrawal date, supersedes / superseded-by, ICS codes, canonical URL, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Is ISO 27001:2013 still current, what replaced it, and what is the exact title to cite?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: Publishers named; quarterly.
wanted.rights_needed: Bibliographic metadata compiled from public catalogues; declare each publisher's catalogue terms. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: Publisher catalogues and OBP. Text of standards is out of scope and must not be included.
wanted.why: Engineering and compliance agents cite withdrawn editions constantly.

wanted.title: US public procurement notices (SAM.gov + state portals) normalised daily
wanted.summary: Federal and state solicitations in one schema with deadlines, NAICS and set-aside codes.
wanted.what: notice id, source portal, agency, title, type (RFP/RFQ/sources sought/award), NAICS, PSC, set-aside, posted date, response deadline, place of performance, contact (official capacity), attachments URLs, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Find every open federal or Texas solicitation under NAICS 541511 due in the next 14 days."
wanted.coverage_freshness: SAM.gov plus the ten largest state portals; daily.
wanted.rights_needed: Public notices; declare each portal's terms. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: SAM.gov opportunities API and state portal exports.
wanted.why: Sales and bid agents need one schema across portals.

wanted.title: Building code adoption by US jurisdiction: IBC, IRC, IECC, NEC editions, amendments and effective dates
wanted.summary: Which edition of each model code is in force where, and since when.
wanted.what: jurisdiction (state/county/city), code family, model edition adopted, effective date, local amendments reference and URL, enforcing authority, source URL, verified date.
wanted.task: "Which IECC edition applies to a new commercial build in Boise as of today, and are there local amendments?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All states plus the 200 largest cities and counties; quarterly.
wanted.rights_needed: Compiled from public adoption ordinances. Model code text is copyrighted and out of scope. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: State building-code agencies, municipal codes, ICC adoption maps (check terms).
wanted.why: Construction and insurance agents guess at editions today.

wanted.title: US federal agency FOIA officers and state attorney-general consumer-protection contacts, quarterly
wanted.summary: Verified official contacts for the two requests agents draft most: FOIA and consumer complaints.
wanted.what: entity, office, role, name as published, address, phone, email, portal URL, submission requirements, fee schedule reference, verified date.
wanted.task: "Draft and address a FOIA request to the FAA's correct office" and "where does a Nevada consumer file a complaint against a contractor?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All federal agencies with FOIA offices; all 50 state AGs; quarterly.
wanted.rights_needed: Official-capacity contacts; declare as personal data with basis. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: FOIA.gov, agency FOIA pages, state AG sites.
wanted.why: Correctly addressed requests get answered; agents currently guess addresses.

wanted.title: Job title ↔ SOC 2018 ↔ O*NET-SOC crosswalk with skills and typical education, annual
wanted.summary: Map messy job titles to occupation codes and their skills.
wanted.what: raw title (from postings and O*NET alternate titles), SOC 2018 code and title, O*NET-SOC code, match confidence, top skills/knowledge/abilities with importance scores, typical education, BLS median wage reference, O*NET release, snapshot date.
wanted.task: "Classify these 50,000 job postings to SOC codes and list the top skills per code."
wanted.coverage_freshness: All SOC codes; annual with O*NET releases, alternate-title list refreshed quarterly.
wanted.rights_needed: O*NET is CC-BY-4.0, attribution propagates; BLS public domain. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: O*NET database and alternate titles, BLS OES.
wanted.why: HR and labour-market agents need the messy-title layer, which O*NET alone does not give.

wanted.title: US county recorder and assessor office directory with online-search URLs and fee schedules
wanted.summary: For each county: where to search deeds and parcels online, and what it costs.
wanted.what: county FIPS and name, recorder office name, address, phone, online records search URL and vendor, assessor parcel search URL, GIS portal URL, copy and recording fee schedule reference, e-recording availability, verified date.
wanted.task: "Pull the deed history for this parcel in Maricopa County" and "which counties in Georgia support e-recording?"
wanted.coverage_freshness: All 3,143 counties and equivalents; annual, with a change log.
wanted.rights_needed: Compiled from public office pages. Redistribution needed.
wanted.sources_hint: County websites, state associations of counties, e-recording vendor coverage lists.
wanted.why: Real-estate and title agents lose hours to broken links.

wanted.title: Public holidays 2026–2028 for 60 countries with a government source URL per entry (verified tier)
wanted.summary: The upgrade over package-derived holiday tables: every date traced to the gazette or ministry page that declared it.
wanted.what: country, subdivision, date, holiday name (local and English), type (public/bank/regional), observed rule applied, declaring authority, source URL, date verified.
wanted.task: "Build a business-day calendar for our Singapore, Poland and Brazil offices for 2027 that I can defend to auditors."
wanted.coverage_freshness: The 60 largest economies; annual, published each October for the following year, with corrections as gazettes update.
wanted.rights_needed: Original compilation of public facts. Redistribution and training allowed; citation appreciated.
wanted.sources_hint: Official gazettes and ministry announcements. The free seed packets on this repository's releases show the target schema; the value here is the per-entry source.
wanted.why: Payroll and scheduling agents need a source they can cite, not a library's best guess.
